name: grows after wraparound without changing logical order
input: a two-slot deque that wraps before resizing
test:
deque = ResizableDeque(2)
deque.append_right(1)
deque.append_right(2)
assert deque.pop_left() == 1
deque.append_right(3)
deque.append_right(4)
assert deque.capacity == 4
assert deque.to_list() == [2, 3, 4]
deque.append_left(0)
assert deque.to_list() == [0, 2, 3, 4]

name: pops correctly from both ends and retains arbitrary values
input: duplicates and None at opposite ends
test:
deque = ResizableDeque(1)
deque.append_left(None)
deque.append_right('x')
deque.append_left('x')
assert len(deque) == 3
assert deque.pop_right() == 'x'
assert deque.pop_left() == 'x'
assert deque.pop_left() is None
assert len(deque) == 0

name: rejects invalid capacities and empty pops
input: zero, boolean, and empty deque operations
